exposure: maternal body mass index (BMI) in early pregnancy
gestational weight gain (GWG) rate in mid- and late-pregnancy
cohort: The study included 1452 mother-child pairs from a population-based cohort in China.
finding: Increased maternal BMI and gestational weight gain are associated with adverse cardiometabolic profiles in childhood, with the association between maternal BMI and childhood cardiometabolic traits likely mediated by offspring BMI.
